items.title: Weight Loss Drug Stocks Slump. What Ozempic Maker Novo Nordisk Said.
items.summary: Weight loss drug stock leaders slumped on Friday amid updates and ahead of earnings. NVO stock sank under a buy point on trial results. LLY stock dived below support with earnings due next week. Updating the closely watched ZEUS phase 3 clinical trial, Denmark's Novo Nordisk announced overnight that its experimental cardiovascular drug, ziltivekimab — to treat heart disease, kidney disease and inflammation — failed in the late-stage trial.
